# repo_identity { #crossrepo.core.repo_identity }

```python
crossrepo.core.repo_identity(root)
```

Determine the owner and name of a repository.

The origin remote is authoritative, so a repository cloned into a directory
of a different name, or mirrored under a directory named for a different
organisation, is still identified correctly. Directory names are the
fallback for a repository without a remote.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**root**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Location](`crossrepo.location.Location`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Working tree of the repository, on this machine or another.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   ``(owner, repo)``. The owner is an empty string when neither the remote nor the parent directory supplies one.
